items.title: 10.20 Activity series of metals and ease of oxidation (metals ki activity series aur oxidation ki aasani) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.20 with Table 10.2, printed pages 236-237.

blocks.text: Metals ki activity series metals ki reactivity ke hisaab se tarteeb hai, khaas taur par un ke electrons khone aur oxidize hone ke trend (rujhan) ke hisaab se. Series mein oopar wale metals ke standard reduction potentials zyada negative hain, yani woh zyada aasani se electrons kho kar oxidize hote hain; is liye woh reducing agents ka kaam karte hain. Sab se oopar wale metals pani, oxygen aur acid se sab se zyada react karte hain. Misal: caesium aur sodium jaise alkali metals bohat reactive hain, aasani se oxidize hote hain aur pani se tezi se react kar ke ions aur hydrogen gas banate hain.

Is ke ulat series mein neeche wale metals, jaise gold aur silver (noble metals), aasani se oxidize nahi hote. Woh kam reactive hain aur aasani se electrons nahi khote; isi liye pani se react nahi karte.

Series ke sab se neeche wale metals pani, oxygen aur acid se sab se kam react karte hain. Yani series mein metal ki jagah us ke oxidize hone ki aasani aur reactivity se seedha juri hai. Neeche wale metals ke standard reduction potentials zyada positive hain, yani un mein electrons lene aur reduce hone ka trend zyada hai; is liye (un ke ions) oxidizing agents ka kaam karte hain.
Metals ki activity series asal mein reactivity series hi hai.
Khulasa: zyada negative potential wale metals zyada reactive hain aur aasani se oxidize hote hain; zyada positive wale kam reactive hain aur mushkil se oxidize hote hain, jaisa Table 10.2 mein hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Table mein Al³⁺/Al ki value ‘-.1.66’ chhapi hai; sahi −1.66 V hai. Table mein Hg (+0.92 V) Ag (+0.80 V) se oopar rakha gaya hai, halanke tarteeb ke hisab se Ag pehle aana chahiye; accepted (maani hui) value Hg²⁺/Hg ke liye taqreeban +0.85 V hai. Acid wali equation kitab mein M + HCl → MCl + H₂ hai; do-valent metal ke liye balanced form M + 2HCl → MCl₂ + H₂ hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Series ko oopar se neeche parhein: E⁰ zyada negative → metal zyada aasani se electrons deta hai → zyada reactive → behtar reducing agent. H₂ (0.00 V) se oopar wale metals acids se hydrogen nikal sakte hain; neeche wale (Cu, Ag, Au) nahi.

blocks.prompt: Iron dilute HCl se react karta hai magar copper nahi. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Iron (−0.44 V) hydrogen (0.00 V) se oopar hai, is liye woh H⁺ ko electrons de kar H₂ bana deta hai: Fe + 2HCl → FeCl₂ + H₂. Copper (+0.34 V) hydrogen se neeche hai, is liye H⁺ copper se electrons nahi le sakta.

items: Activity (reactivity) series: oxidize hone ki aasani ke hisaab se tarteeb.
Oopar: zyada negative E⁰, strong (taqatwar) reducing agent, pani/oxygen/acid se zyada reactive (Li −3.05 V).
Neeche: zyada positive E⁰, kam reactive, ions oxidizing agents (Au +1.50 V).
